limitations: Forty-second target is service-ready, one computing job, bounded input envelope; not arbitrary inputs or boot time.
C11 40-job numerical/stability evidence and C12 one-job browser evidence have distinct application hashes; C12 changes access/UI/validation only, not numerical pipeline.
Prior unexpected whole-board restart cause remains unknown; no OOM/reset during this C11 40-job window.
P6 functional netlist simulation remains tool-license limited; no new RTL or synthesis.
Browser automated ZIP/screenshot download API not verified; HTTP ZIP SHA/CRC/all members verified.
Resource trace includes swap and low CMA free space; no zero-swap claim.
